t: Refining Web Scraping: From Hack to Hardened Tool in Pipulate
s: Details the AI-assisted debugging and refactoring of Pipulate's web scraping functionality, evolving a clever workaround into a robust, dedicated tool for browser automation.
sub: Iterative debugging of Pipulate's 'pip' object for web scraping.
Repurposing 'browser_hijack_workflow_complete' as a temporary scrape solution.
Blueprint for creating a dedicated 'browser_scrape_page' tool.
Refactoring 'pip.scrape()' to use the new specialist tool.
